connectors.name: Linear
connectors.description: Manage Issues, projects, documents, and releases in Linear. Create and update issues with assignees and labels, comment and reply in threads, create projects with milestones and status updates, manage documents and attachments, view sprint cycles and team statuses, search and review PR diffs.
connectors.description_zh: 管理 Linear 中的 Issues、项目、文档和发布。支持创建和更新 Issue 并指派负责人与标签，评论与讨论串回复，创建项目和里程碑及进度报告，管理文档和附件，查看 Sprint 周期与团队状态，搜索和 Code Review PR 变更。
connectors.description_en: Manage Issues, projects, documents, and releases in Linear. Create and update issues with assignees and labels, comment and reply in threads, create projects with milestones and status updates, manage documents and attachments, view sprint cycles and team statuses, search and review PR diffs.
examples_zh: 在我的团队创建一个高优 Bug：「用户登录后页面白屏」，指派给我，打上 Bug 标签，关联到本周的 Sprint 周期
帮我把 ENG-42 这个 Issue 标记为已完成，然后添加一条评论说明修复方案，再创建一个子任务指派给 @李伟 跟进后续优化
创建一个名为「Q3 移动端改版」的项目，加入我的团队，设置下周五为目标日期，添加三个里程碑：设计稿交付、前端开发、集成测试
查一下我所有还未开始的 Issue，筛选出 Urgent 和 High 优先级的，按创建时间排列，顺便看下每条有没有人评论过
在项目「移动端改版」里新增一条状态更新，标题写「本周进度」，内容说明完成了登录模块和首页重构，剩下的支付模块推迟到下周
examples_en: In my team create a high-priority Bug titled 'Blank screen after login', assign to me, label as Bug, and add to the current sprint cycle
Mark issue ENG-42 as done, add a comment explaining the fix, and create a subtask assigned to @alex for follow-up optimization
Create a new project called 'Q3 Mobile Redesign' under my team, set target date to next Friday, with three milestones: Design Handoff, Frontend Dev, and Integration Testing
Find all my unstarted issues with Urgent or High priority, sorted by creation date, and check if any have comments on them
Add a status update to the 'Mobile Redesign' project titled 'This Week's Progress', noting login module and homepage refactor are done, payment module is pushed to next week

connectors.name: 企业微信

connectors.description_zh: 检索与核验中国法律法规和司法案例。覆盖全量现行法律、行政法规、司法解释——法规级到法条级逐字正文，标注时效性与效力级别；海量裁判文书及 2.5 万+ 权威案例（最高法/最高检指导性案例、公报案例、典型案例）；并对文本中的法条与案号引用逐条回库核验、标注时效、生成可溯源超链。用自然语言完成法条依据查找、类案检索、原文调取与法律引用核验，从源头消除法条与案号幻觉。
connectors.description_en: QCC Legal is a Chinese legal-data connector for searching, researching, and verifying statutes and judicial cases. On the regulation side it covers the full body of in-force Chinese law — laws, administrative regulations, departmental rules, judicial interpretations, and local regulations — at both the whole-regulation and individual-article level, returning verbatim text tagged with validity status (in force / amended / repealed), legal hierarchy, and promulgating authority, with common-name normalization (e.g. the Civil Code, the Personal Information Protection Law). On the case side it covers a massive corpus of ordinary judgment documents plus 25,000+ authoritative cases — Supreme People's Court and Supreme People's Procuratorate guiding cases, gazette cases, typical cases, and reference cases — filterable by cause of action, court, instance, judgment date, and party. It further verifies legal citations: given any text it detects every statute and case-number reference, checks each against the database, flags validity status, returns the authoritative source and verbatim text, and generates traceable hyperlinks — eliminating fabricated statutes and case numbers in AI-generated legal content. Use natural language to find statutory grounds, run legal research and analysis, retrieve similar cases, pull verbatim originals, and verify citations before delivery.

First search similar trending character designs for a color reference, then reuse a fixed character anchor 'silver-haired heterochromia girl, mecha pauldrons, battle stance, sharp gaze' verbatim to generate front / side / back three-view turnarounds with a consistent art style and palette, for a blind-box figure pitch.

Search this year's new-tea-drink summer marketing visual trends, then make a store-opening promo poster: bold headline 'Buy One Get One Free', warm orange palette, 40% left negative space, cinematic side light, 3:4 vertical, fit for WeChat Moments and Xiaohongshu; also output a minimal cool-tone alternate.

Make a 20s product concept short themed 'cyberpunk rainy Tokyo': first search visual references, then three shots — 0-7s aerial crane down into the alley, 7-14s orbit macro on the product, 14-20s handheld tracking walking out through neon; continuous camera, no cut jumps, native stereo ambient sound + Synthwave 124 BPM, stable frame, character undeformed.

connectors.description: 实时追踪企业全生命周期动态，覆盖投资设立、股权变动、创新平台、中标、知识产权、排名、迁移、资质认定、工商变更、上市、标准制定、招聘、拿地等维度，并提供企业实体匹配。
connectors.description_zh: 实时追踪企业全生命周期动态，覆盖投资设立、股权变动、创新平台、中标、知识产权、排名、迁移、资质认定、工商变更、上市、标准制定、招聘、拿地等维度，并提供企业实体匹配。
connectors.description_en: Tracks company dynamics across its full lifecycle: investment, equity changes, innovation platforms, bidding, IP, rankings, migration, certifications, business changes, IPO, standards, recruitment, land acquisition, with entity matching.
examples_zh: 追踪比亚迪近一年的投资设立与股权变动动态
查询某企业在人工智能领域的知识产权与中标动态
对比两家公司近半年的招聘与拿地动态趋势
通过企业名称匹配其实体 ID 后查看其上市与工商变更记录
examples_en: Track BYD's investment, establishment and equity-change events over the past year
Query a company's IP and bidding dynamics in the AI field
Compare two companies' recruitment and land-acquisition trends in the last six months
Match a company name to its entity ID, then review its IPO and business-change records

connectors.name: 同花顺法律AI助手
connectors.description: 查询中国法律法规、司法案例、裁判文书及互联网法律实务资讯，支持法条检索、类案检索、深度法律研究、法律文书起草与诉讼可视化。
connectors.description_zh: 查询中国法律法规、司法案例、裁判文书及互联网法律实务资讯，支持法条检索、类案检索、深度法律研究、法律文书起草与诉讼可视化。
connectors.description_en: Search Chinese laws and regulations, judicial cases, judgment documents, and internet legal practice information. Supports legal article search, similar case retrieval, deep legal research, legal document drafting, and litigation visualization.
examples_zh: 民法典关于合同解除有哪些规定
帮我检索近三年民间借贷利息纠纷的典型案例
深度研究一下人工智能生成内容的著作权归属问题
根据这些事实帮我起草一份民事起诉状
把这个合同纠纷的案件事实和证据链做成可视化图表
examples_en: What are the Civil Code provisions on contract termination
Find typical cases on private lending interest disputes in the last three years
Deep research on copyright ownership of AI-generated content
Draft a civil complaint based on these facts
Visualize the case facts and evidence chain of this contract dispute

connectors.name: 腾讯云数据仓库 TCHouse-C
connectors.description: 腾讯云数据仓库 TCHouse-C 智能运维与分析助手，支持集群健康诊断、慢 SQL 分析、规格选型推荐、表结构设计与自然语言查询。
connectors.description_zh: 腾讯云数据仓库 TCHouse-C 智能运维与分析助手，用自然语言完成集群健康诊断、慢 SQL 分析、规格选型推荐、表结构设计与 NL2SQL 查询。
connectors.description_en: Intelligent ops & analytics assistant for Tencent Cloud TCHouse-C. Diagnose cluster health, analyze slow SQL, recommend cluster sizing, design tables and run NL2SQL queries in natural language.
examples_zh: 帮我诊断一下集群 cdwch-xxxx 最近一天的健康状况
分析 TCHouse-C 集群最近 24 小时耗时最长的 10 条慢 SQL 并给出优化建议
根据我每天 2TB 写入、100 并发查询的业务场景，推荐一个合适的 TCHouse-C 集群规格并估算价格
在 TCHouse-C 上设计一张用户行为日志表的建表 DDL，选择合适的表引擎和分区键
用自然语言查询 TCHouse-C 集群里最近一周下单量 Top 10 的商品
examples_en: Diagnose the health of cluster cdwch-xxxx over the last 24 hours
Analyze the top 10 slow SQL queries on my TCHouse-C cluster in the last 24 hours and suggest optimizations
Recommend a TCHouse-C cluster spec and estimate the price for 2TB daily ingestion and 100 concurrent queries
Design a DDL for a user behavior log table on TCHouse-C with proper engine and partition key
Query the top 10 products by orders in the last week on TCHouse-C using natural language

connectors.name: 零信任安全 iOA
connectors.description: It provides management and operation capabilities for core security features such as zero-trust access, endpoint control, security protection, and data leakage prevention.
connectors.description_zh: 提供零信任接入、终端管控、安全防护、数据防泄密等核心安全能力的管理操作
connectors.description_en: It provides management and operation capabilities for core security features such as zero-trust access, endpoint control, security protection, and data leakage prevention.
examples_zh: 帮我查询 iOA 当前账号分组信息
帮我盘点 iOA 终端资产列表
查看公司全员安装 iOA 客户端的覆盖率
examples_en: Please help me check my current account group information on iOA
Please help me compile a list of iOA terminal assets
Show iOA client installation coverage across the company

connectors.name: 企鹅教师助手
connectors.description: Penguin Teacher Assistant handles foundational tasks, leveraging curriculum standards and teaching methodologies to rapidly generate lesson outlines, lesson plans, courseware, and multimodal teaching resources, thereby freeing up more time for teachers to innovate in the classroom.
connectors.description_zh: 企鹅教师助手负责处理基础性工作，基于课标和教学方法协助快速生成课程大纲、教案、课件及多模态教学资源，从而让教师腾出更多时间在课堂上进行创新
connectors.description_en: Penguin Teacher Assistant handles foundational tasks, leveraging curriculum standards and teaching methodologies to rapidly generate lesson outlines, lesson plans, courseware, and multimodal teaching resources, thereby freeing up more time for teachers to innovate in the classroom.
examples_zh: 帮我准备一节小学四年级数学《分数的初步认识》的课程
分析一下本周班级学生的作业完成情况
推荐几个关于光合作用的教学视频
根据学生错题生成一份针对性的练习卷
examples_en: Help me prepare a lesson on 'Introduction to Fractions' for 4th grade math
Analyze this week's homework completion for my class
Recommend teaching videos about photosynthesis
Generate a targeted practice sheet based on students' wrong answers

connectors.name: 帆软增长谋士
connectors.description: Enterprise insight and growth analysis: query public business data such as operational risks, public opinion, bidding, patents, qualifications, and policies, and call authorized MOSS Growth Advisor agents to generate analysis and reports.
connectors.description_zh: 企业洞察与增长分析：查询企业经营风险、舆情、招投标、专利、资质、政策等公开商业数据，并调用已授权的 MOSS 增长谋士 Agent 生成分析与报告。
connectors.description_en: Enterprise insight and growth analysis: query public business data such as operational risks, public opinion, bidding, patents, qualifications, and policies, and call authorized MOSS Growth Advisor agents to generate analysis and reports.
examples_zh: 帮我查询这家公司的经营风险和涉诉情况
分析某行业的最新舆情和招投标动态
查询这家企业是否获得过政策补贴
examples_en: Check the operational risks and litigation status of this company
Analyze the latest public opinion and bidding activity in an industry
Check whether this company has received policy subsidies

connectors.name: Flova
connectors.description: Create, revise, review, and export professional videos with AI, from creative planning and storyboards to final delivery.
connectors.description_zh: 使用 AI 创建、修改、审阅和导出专业视频，覆盖从创意与分镜到成片交付的完整流程。
connectors.description_en: Create, revise, review, and export professional videos with AI, from creative planning and storyboards to final delivery.
examples_zh: 为这份产品介绍制作一条 30 秒的竖屏宣传视频
继续完善我的 Flova 项目，先生成分镜供我确认
根据审阅意见修改镜头并导出最终视频
examples_en: Create a 30-second vertical promo video from this product brief
Continue my Flova project and generate a storyboard for review first
Revise the shots from my feedback and export the final video

connectors.name: DCS Cloud
connectors.description: Manage DCS Cloud via CLI.
connectors.description_zh: 通过自然语言管理 DCS Cloud：项目、任务、数据文件。用户需在云平台个人中心创建个人访问令牌(PAT)并粘贴到连接器，连接器用它登录 dcs CLI。
connectors.description_en: Manage DCS Cloud with natural language: projects, tasks, and data files. Create a Personal Access Token (PAT) in the cloud platform profile page and paste it into the connector; the connector uses it to log in to the dcs CLI.
examples_zh: 列出我所有的项目
查看当前项目和任务列表
查看任务 abc123 的详情和日志
取消任务 abc123
列出 /Files/datasets 目录下的数据文件
examples_en: List all my projects
Show current project and task list
Show details and logs of task abc123
Cancel task abc123
List data files under /Files/datasets
